items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: Most of my father taught them, taught all of us how to handle our instruments.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Yeah, he was pretty good. I suppose you know who he learned from? Mostly your father I guess and around the family.
Most of my father taught them, taught all of us how to handle our instruments.
When they were young, did they all play your father's bass? Did they get instruments right away or what?
